Cyberdeck.name: Cyberdeck
Cyberdeck.description: Einfaches Deck fürs Netrunning. 7 Slots. Weitere Informationen auf Seite 353.

Cyberdeck (Excellent).name: Cyberdeck (Hervorragende Qualität)
Cyberdeck (Excellent).description: Hervorragendes Deck fürs Netrunning. 9 Slots. Weitere Informationen auf Seite 353.

Cyberdeck (Poor).name: Cyberdeck (Schlechte Qualität)
Cyberdeck (Poor).description: Schlechtes Deck fürs Netrunning. 5 Slots. Weitere Informationen auf Seite 353.

Battleglove.name: Kampfhandschuh
Battleglove.description:
An exotic heavy gauntlet, that covers your hand and forearm. Provides three option slots.

Remember to set HL to 0 when installing cyberware options.

Smart Glasses.name: Smart-Brille
Smart Glasses.description:
Eyewear with two options slots for cybereye options.

Remember to set HL to 0 when installing cyberware options.

Agent.name: Agent
Agent.description: A Standard Quality Smartpohone with onboard AI that provides +2 Library Search, +2 Wardrobe & Style depending on circumstance. Includes a touchscreen, microphone, camera, and flashlight.

Audio Recorder.name: Audiorekorder
Audio Recorder.description: Record up to 24 hours of audio on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.LKAYRh3Oecskc6kH]{Memory Chip}.

Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors.name: Automatische Lärmdämmung
Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors.description: Wearer is immune to loud sounds like those produced by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.e8gDMbdK1oPKwhqW]{Flashbang Grenades}.

Binoculars.name: Feldstecher
Binoculars.description: Gut fürs den Blick in die Ferne. Vergrößerung x2 oder x3.

Carryall.name: Reisetasche
Carryall.description: A bag to carry and conceal items.

Chemical Analyzer.name: Chemisches Analysegerät
Chemical Analyzer.description:
Determines the chemical composition of a sample.

Your GM may require a related Intelligence or Tech check.

Computer.name: Computer
Computer.description: A budget desktop or laptop that cannot be used as a Portable Net Arch.

Cryopump.name: Cryopumpe
Cryopump.description:
Briefcase-sized tool used for hooking up a wounded person. Places them in stasis.

Can only be used by a Medtech with Cryosystem training.

Cryotank.name: Cryotank
Cryotank.description:
Holds a fully-sized human, heals injuries faster than normal.

Can only be used by a Medtech with Cryosystem training.

Disposable Cell Phone.name: Wegwerfhandy
Disposable Cell Phone.description: Für Anrufe. Kann man wegwerfen, wenn es sein muss.

Drum Synthesizer.name: Synth-Schlagzeug
Drum Synthesizer.description: Makes drum sounds when connected to @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Zp8YbDBMTCl7sy61]{amplifier}.

Duct Tape.name: Klebeband
Duct Tape.description: Erhältlich in vielen Farben, einschließlich der Nachtleuchtenden.

Electric Guitar/Other Instrument.name: Elektrische Gitarre/Anderes Instrument
Electric Guitar/Other Instrument.description: Musical instrument. Electric instruments require an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Zp8YbDBMTCl7sy61]{amplifier} or other similar output device.

Flashlight.name: Taschenlampe
Flashlight.description: 100 m weiter Lichtstrahl. Hält nach Aufladung 10 Stunden.

Grapple Gun.name: Halteseilkanone
Grapple Gun.description:
Range: 30m/yds.

Not usable as weapon, cannot be used to Grapple an opponent.

Handcuffs.name: Handschellen
Handcuffs.description: Physically restrain any individual with less than 10 BODY.

Homing Tracer.name: Peilsucher
Homing Tracer.description: Track a linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.IqXTqNGBmSuigIWv]{Tracer Button} up to 1 mile.

Linear Frame β (Beta).name: Lineartragwerk β (Beta)
Linear Frame β (Beta).description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 14 while plugged in

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).name: Lineartragwerk (Sigma)
Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 1 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plug}
  • Increases BODY to 12

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system.

Medtech Bag.name: MediTech-Tasche
Medtech Bag.description: A bag filled with basic medical equipment.

Memory Chip.name: Speicherchip
Memory Chip.description:
Universal data storage device.

Use @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.gAfBLrpJzkKVtr8o]{Memory Chip} to track items installed into @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Sockets}.

Personal CarePak.name: Persönliches CarePak
Personal CarePak.description: Contains a toothbrush and other personal grooming items.

Pocket Amplifier.name: Taschenverstärker
Pocket Amplifier.description: @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.MfuoJ69NL1FiP7B8]{Battery} powered electronic device that can support up to two electronic instruments.

Radio Scanner/Music Player.name: Sendersucher/Musik­wiedergabe
Radio Scanner/Music Player.description: Spiele die heißeste Musik ab und schalte auf einen Radiosender im Umkreis von 1,5 km.

Spray Paint.name: Spray Paint
Spray Paint.description: Generic spray paint. Make some art or blind a camera.

Tech Bag.name: Tech-Tasche
Tech Bag.description: Tool bag filled with basic tools for everyday repairs.

Techscanner.name: TechScanner
Techscanner.description: An electronic device that grants +2 to Basic Tech, Cybertech, Electronic/Security Tech, Weaponstech, Land Vehicle Tech, Sea Vehicle Tech, Air Vehicle Tech checks.

Techtool.name: Techwerkzeug
Techtool.description: Multi-purpose tool that fits in your pocket.

Tent and Camping Equipment.name: Zelt und Campingausrüstung
Tent and Camping Equipment.description: Provides shelter from the weather and space for one person.

Tracer Button.name: Peilsender
Tracer Button.description: Can be tracked from up to a mile away with a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.QIHx5oQOirtTlAaD]{Homing Tracer} & similar @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.o3lADTIXaa3eLryF]{Cyberware Options}.

Vial of Biotoxin.name: Flasche mit Biotoxin
Vial of Biotoxin.description: Deals [[/r 3d6dmg#Biotoxin Damage]]{3d6 Damage} directly to HP unless subject makes a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. Armor does not apply.

Vial of Poison.name: Flasche mit Gift
Vial of Poison.description: Deals [[/r 2d6dmg#Poison Damage]]{2d6 Damage} directly to HP unless subject makes a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. Armor does not apply.

Video Camera.name: Videokamera
Video Camera.description: Record up to 12 hours of video on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.LKAYRh3Oecskc6kH]{Memory Chip}.
